items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That's why Joe said, “just call me that old soldier and just fade away."

ctx.x: But, this is standard you had to meet as an instrumentalist to make the date. I think you're very proud of the fact that ‘Trane never played with another trombonist. That is probably because of the technical challenge opening with him. So, there is a significance in this. I mean, you don’t like to be asked, “why were you on that date?” But…

I’m kind of like Jay and every other trombone player, sometimes we are guilty, I know I am… I have a friend that went to school with me, from grade school. He was with the ‘76ers. He was our champion basketball player. He was just in Detroit when I was there. He said, “Look at it this way Curtis.” I said, “There are just things I can’t do anymore.” He said, “I go out to the playground and play with the kids and my knee keeps giving out on me just like the way it did on the basketball court. What we do, Curtis…”…
